punchline: At one hospital, anesthesia problems were about four times as common in operations starting at 4 p.m. as in those at 9 a.m.
thirty_sec: Daniel Pink describes Duke hospital data on about 90,000 surgeries: anesthesia problems spiked for afternoon starts. Danish schoolkids also scored worse later in the day, but a twenty-to-thirty-minute break more than made up the drop. His own fix is the nappuccino: drink a coffee, nap for under twenty minutes, and wake up as the caffeine lands.
